label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.75… supports Whatever operates, transiently or…
note: Q.75 a.2 co. says 'non enim est operari nisi entis in actu'; the claim reads it only of causing another (its example: the hot thing heats). The premise states it of operating as such, including immanent operation such as understanding; that extension is the analyst's.
